title: Beurling Criteria for Reproducing Kernels
summary: A classical theorem due to Beurling-Lax-Halmos characterizes the invariant subspaces of the unilateral shift as ranges of isometric multiplication operators acting on the Hardy space. The class of Beurling-Lax-Halmos (BLH) pairs of reproducing kernels is introduced, consisting of those pairs that admit an analogue of this theorem. The BLH class is, under varying hypotheses, characterized in several equivalent ways: dilation-theoretically, via a complete Leech interpolation property, and through a sums-of-squares-inspired Agler-style decomposition.
